page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with no margin notes. Running head at the top; page number at the head.

main_text.l: Quum ij qui eadē in familia funt,quíp
urbanus illis deeft, qui ius inter illos
fi ex familia filij ferui'ue per adeptio-
nem fui iuris exierint,tum quia fub im
ri prima fpecie uidetur. Quum igitur
Atque hoc eft quod uulgo dicitur,

page.notes: Running head and page number are partly uncertain: the head is in ornamented type and could not be read. Some words are doubtful in the scan, including "Firmamētum", "quefatisfacere", "quía", "funt,quíp" and "extinguí"; they are copied as printed. No marginal notes are printed on this page.
